hooks.name: hilbish.cancel
description: Sent when the user cancels their command input with Ctrl-C.

hooks.name: hilbish.cd
description: Sent when the current directory of the shell is changed.
Since 3.0, hilbish.cd is thrown when fs.cd is called.

vars.Name: path
Doc: Absolute path of the directory that was changed to.

vars.Name: oldPath
Doc: Absolute path of the directory Hilbish was in before the change.

hooks.name: hilbish.exit
description: Sent when Hilbish is going to exit.

vars.Name: notification
Doc: The notificatione. See the notifications feature doc for its properties.

hooks.name: hilbish.rawInput
description: Thrown when the user has entered text in the prompt and pressed enter, before any processing.

vars.Name: input
Doc: The raw input the user typed.

hooks.name: hilbish.vimAction
description: Sent when the user does a "vim action," such as yanking or pasting text.
See `doc vim-mode actions` for a list of available actions.

vars.Name: actionName
Doc: The name of the Vim action that was done.

vars.Name: args
Doc: Table of args relating to the Vim action.

hooks.name: hilbish.vimMode
description: Sent when the Vim mode of Hilbish is changed (like from insert to normal mode).
This can be used to change the prompt and notify based on Vim mode.

vars.Name: modeName
Doc: The mode that has been set. Can be: `insert`, `normal`, `delete` or `replace`.
